sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 418.6 ± 111.8 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: NOT MEASURED for OR5AU1 specifically; construct was made for heterologous expression but surface display and functional readout for OR5AU1 are not reported in the cited ledger line.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly names OR5AU1 among the ORs cloned with N-terminal FLAG+Rho tags on the full-length receptor. The topology landmarks show no signal peptide and place residues 1–76 extracellular; TM1 begins at residue 77, leaving the N-terminus as the unique extracellular terminus. A prepend (insert_after_residue=0) is therefore the topology-derived junction, 76+ residues from TM1. L2 confirms surface display of the identical construct design for a related OR (OR51T1) but does not name OR5AU1, so validation remains detected_only. OR5AU1 full-length receptor cloned into pME18S with N-terminal FLAG and 20-aa bovine rhodopsin epitope tags fused upstream of residue 1; expressed in HEK293 and LNCaP cells. Topology landmarks place residues 1–76 extracellular with no signal peptide, making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus and the only possible location for the reported N-terminal tag.

sources.claim: Each of the amplified receptor genes was inserted into the pME18S vector to generate OR proteins fused with N-terminal epitope tags of FLAG and 20 N-terminal amino acids of bovine rhodopsin.

literature_notes: L2 demonstrates surface display of the N-terminal FLAG tag for OR51T1 using the same pME18S FLAG+Rho construct design, providing indirect support that the N-terminal tag strategy reaches the extracellular face in ORs. However, because L2 names OR51T1 and not OR5AU1, it cannot elevate OR5AU1's validation level beyond detected_only; it was therefore used only as contextual support and not as the primary grounding clip. No ledger evidence supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for OR5AU1 or a close ortholog.
